name: Social network with chronological feed and private profiles

mentions.name: Social network with chronological feed and private profiles
mentions.description: This social network features a chronological feed and private profiles, with the goal of building a platform that doesn't harm users in any way and provides full control over their data. A waitlist is open for early access.
mentions.problem: Social networks can harm users and don't give them full control over their data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Me and my brother are working a social 
network with chronological feed and private profiles.

Goal is to build a social network that doesn't harm the user in any way and provides full control over their data.
